scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “The cotype–cotype conjecture under the approximation property” (preprints/The-cotype-cotype-conjecture-under-the-approximation-property-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 326 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c2f55fe9562e2ee7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let X be a nonzero real Banach space with the ordinary approximation property. Then X is K-convex if and only if Cq(X) < ∞ and Cr(X∗ ) < ∞ for some q, r ∈ [2, ∞). The exponents q and r may differ. The forward implication holds for every real Banach space, without an approximation hypothesis.
